name: game-barrier
description: Stops irreversible calls: force-push to main, reset --hard, rm -r outside the project, publishing, DROP TABLE, and file edits outside the project

mode.title: Mode
mode.description: block refuses the call before it runs; warn lets it run and tells Claude and you; off stops checking. /barrier changes it for later sessions too

allow.title: Also allowed folders
allow.description: Comma-separated absolute folders (~ allowed) where edits and rm -r are fine besides the project, ~/.claude and temp folders
